notes: Overview: Mid-market B2B SaaS focused on embedded search and in-app knowledge discovery for product teams. Looking to improve top-k relevance in the product help center and in-app search with a reranking tier on top of existing sparse retrieval.

Initial ask on call (2026-02-24): wants evaluation flow: 1) hosted API POC for 2 weeks using their 10k eval set and offline scoring; 2) performance demo + pricing for Dedicated if quality/latency OK. Emphasis on small-window reranking (top 20 -> top 5).
POC scope: endpoint for reranking (batch + per-request), consistent scoring for offline evals, ability to pin model versions, and a light-weight A/B rollout for canarying new ranker weights.

Latency/throughput targets: interactive rerank p95 <= 200ms for single-request rerank (top 20 -> top 5), sustained throughput ~40-60 qps during peak; offline scoring job for nightly re-rank of 1M doc pairs (batch performance important).

Model preferences: prefer open models or small cross-encoder variants; interested in Redwood's rerank-optimized variants and quantized options for Dedicated. Wants fallback policy to cheaper embed+light-rerank when capacity constrained.

Evaluation plan: they provided eval_set_v1.csv (10,234 queries) with judgments. Will run our baseline (deduped BM25+cross-encoder) and expect MAP/NDCG improvements >10% to move forward to Dedicated conversation.

Security/compliance: must integrate with SSO (SAML), need SOC 2 evidence, audit logging for token-level actions, and KMS integration for any customer keys. EU user residency is a plus—asking about region pinning for Dedicated.

Commercial notes: budget band indicated 50k-200k ARR. Pricing sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated with a 12-month reserved if unit costs align. Asked for a mid-market pricing worksheet (sent Drive link).

Meeting quotes: 'We can't regress quality for the sake of latency — accuracy first, then optimize cost.' — Head of Product. Also 'If Hosted POC looks good we want a model for predictable pricing and isolation' — CTO.

Timeline / recent activities: - 2025-09-18 inbound trial signup; - 2025-10-05 product demo (hosted API); - 2026-02-24 deep-dive on reranking use-case (Fireflies ff_2026-02-24_SG-71); - 2026-03-02 security sync with infra (Fireflies ff_2026-03-02_SG-89); - 2026-03-03 POC kickoff prep (AE/SE alignment).

Technical notes (SE): they will supply retrieval top-100 dumps and a labeled eval set. Need example scoring script (python) for offline metrics and a recommended batching config for rerank endpoint. Also asked about KV cache behaviour for repeated prefix scoring — SE recommended prefix caching and deterministic weights for reproducibility.

POC success criteria: 1) visible NDCG lift >10% vs current baseline; 2) hosted API p95 <=200ms on test traffic; 3) reproducible offline scoring pipeline that matches online scores within small epsilon. If met, move to Dedicated capacity pricing + contract.
